title: The Ember Crown
synopsis: A village lamp-keeper learns she can wield the last of the world's magic. With a wizard, an archer and a stolen crown to win back, Ada must face the Shadow Sorcerer before every light goes out.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Every evening, the village of Dunmere lit its lamps with Ember Light, a warm golden glow that came from the Ember Crown, far away in the capital. But this autumn, the lamps had begun to dim.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Ada, a sixteen year old lamp-keeper, did not believe in magic. Then one evening the lamp in her hands went out, and her own fingertips began to glow.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: That night a black storm rolled over the hills, and in it marched the Hollow Knights, shadow soldiers with no faces. They had come for the village, and for the girl who could make light.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: Stay back! I do not know what I am doing, but you will not touch my village!

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: A wave of golden fire burst from her hands, and the Hollow Knights melted into smoke. Ada fell to her knees, shaking, while the whole village stared in silence.

scenes.speaker: orrin
scenes.text: Well done, child. I am Orrin, once a master of the Star Tower. The sorcerer Vexar has stolen the Ember Crown. You are the Ember's heir, Ada, and the world needs you.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Ada looked at her glowing hands, and at the lamps of her home, and she made her choice. At dawn she and Orrin left Dunmere together, and the quest began.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The old Star Tower stood broken on a windy cliff, but inside, its great library still glowed with tiny drifting lights. Here, Orrin began to teach.

scenes.speaker: orrin
scenes.text: Magic is not a weapon, Ada. It is a conversation with the world. First you listen. Then you ask.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: For many days she trained. She lit a hundred candles without touching them. She lifted stones with a whisper. But whenever she grew angry, her fire ran wild and scorched the curtains.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: I can do it when I am calm, Master. But when I think about the Hollow Knights, my fire runs away from me. How do I stop it?

scenes.speaker: orrin
scenes.text: Fire fed by anger consumes the one who holds it. The Ember Crown was forged from hope. Remember what you are protecting, not what you fear.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Far away, in the Shadow Citadel, Lord Vexar set the stolen Ember Crown on a black altar. Its golden fire turned violet in his hands, and every light in the kingdom flickered.

scenes.speaker: vexar
scenes.text: Soon every flame will answer to me. Let the girl come. A little spark has never beaten the night.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: To reach the Citadel, Ada and Orrin had to cross the Whispering Forest, where the trees remember every traveler, and whisper their secrets back to them.

scenes.speaker: tomi
scenes.text: Stop right there! This is my forest. Hand over your gold, or my arrow will find your hat.

scenes.speaker: orrin
scenes.text: We have no gold, young archer, only a dangerous errand. The Ember Crown is stolen, and this girl is the last hope of the realm.

scenes.speaker: tomi
scenes.text: The Hollow Knights burned my family's hut last winter. Fine. I know every path in these woods. I will guide you. But if you stumble, I will not carry you.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: That night, the forest tested them. The trees whispered to Ada in her own voice. You are only a village girl. You will fail. You will lose everyone.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: I am afraid. But being afraid is not the same as being beaten. I am still here.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: A soft golden light, calm and steady, spread from her hands. The whispers fell silent, the great trees bowed their branches, and a path of glowing mushrooms opened toward the Citadel.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The Shadow Citadel rose from a lake of black glass, its towers scraping the clouds. Lightning crawled between its spires, and the air tasted of cold iron.

scenes.speaker: tomi
scenes.text: Two thousand Hollow Knights guard that gate, so we cannot fight our way in. But there is a drain tunnel under the east wall. I scouted it last winter.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: They crept through the dripping tunnel under the walls, lit by Ada's soft glow. Blue crystals pulsed in the dark like sleeping stars.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Inside the great hall, Lord Vexar was waiting, as if he had known they were coming all along. Behind them, the Hollow Knights sealed every door.

scenes.speaker: vexar
scenes.text: Hello again, Master Orrin. Did you tell the girl I was your finest student? You taught me everything. You never taught me to be satisfied.

scenes.speaker: orrin
scenes.text: Ada, the Crown is on the altar. Take it and run to the tower roof. I will hold them as long as I can.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Orrin slammed his staff down, and a wall of golden light split the hall in two. Ada seized the Ember Crown and, with Tomi at her side, ran for the stairs.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: On the highest roof of the Citadel, the wind howled around Ada and Tomi. Below them, the whole kingdom lay in darkness, one tiny light after another going out.

scenes.speaker: tomi
scenes.text: They are coming up the stairs. Whatever you have to do, Ada, do it now. I will hold the door.

scenes.speaker: vexar
scenes.text: You cannot wear it, child. The Crown's fire will burn you to ash. Give it to me, and I will let your friends live.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: Orrin taught me that fire fed by anger consumes the one who holds it. But fire fed by hope can light the whole world.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: She placed the Ember Crown on her own head. Golden light exploded from the roof of the Citadel and raced across the sky, like the sun rising at midnight.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: One by one, the lamps of the kingdom woke again. The Hollow Knights dissolved into mist, and Vexar's violet fire shrank to a candle flame in his trembling hands.

scenes.speaker: vexar
scenes.text: I only wanted the fear to stop. I thought the dark would keep me safe.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: We all fear the dark, Vexar. But you do not beat it by becoming it. You beat it with a light, and you share it.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Orrin was found alive, leaning on his broken staff and smiling. Vexar returned to the Star Tower to study the old books and learn the long way. And Ada carried the Crown home, so that every lamp in Dunmere would shine again.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Every winter, the people of the kingdom light a lamp in each window, to remember the night a village girl became the keeper of the Ember. And that is the story of Ada, and of how the lights came back.
